contents.direction_remark: top of page, begins without introduction: continues the cipher blocks that end f. 12v (the two verses announced wa-l-awwal / wa-l-thani); upper lines partly under a water stain; many dotted-stroke dividers visible (about 3-4 per line) but not counted exactly; signs are angular/hooked

contents.text: قلت لنفسي حين مال [?] لي [?] وزاره الشام وفعل / الاتام [?]

ان الحجي [?] ان التقي [?] تقنعني بقولهم هذا او زير الشام / الاصل تقنعني وليس يلحن فلا توهمه منهم فان حذف / النون جائز على التقدير وكتب للمخدوم المشار اليه / اسبغ الله ظلاله من نظم الشريف اي لعل [?] الهاره [?]

Lines 5-10 are text about a verse, not a clear 'fa-halaltuhu' answer; their link to the ciphers is uncertain. contents.text: فحلّه وهذا من اصعب ما كتب له واقسم لو راى هذا / احد من ارباب التصانيف الفقيهة لفضّله على كل حل / ولاعياه حلّه وانا مقر والله انه لو كتب بي لعجزت عنه / فان البشر في نفس الامر سبع كلمات متشابهة / غريبة التركيب فسبحان الوهاب
لكل [?] طرف بكوه [?] لكل طرف كبوه / لكل نفس صبوه لكل سيف نبوه  (two hemistichs per line; words uncertain)
وكتبت له وقد عزمت على السفر ان شاء الله تعالى

contents.direction_remark: new block, written for the patron when the compiler was about to travel; angular signs with dotted dividers, about 4 per line

correspondents.translit: the patron (unnamed); line 9 'wa-katabtu lahu' - I wrote to him when I had resolved to travel

technique_remarks: 'fa-halla-hu wa-hadha min as'ab ma kutiba lahu' ('he solved it; this is one of the hardest things written to him'); 'wa-aqsamu law ra'a hadha ahad min arbab al-tasanif al-faqihiya la-faddalahu ... wa-la-'ayyahu hallu-hu' (an oath that any author would have preferred it and that solving it would have exhausted him); 'wa-ana muqirr wa-llahi annahu law kutiba bi la-'ajaztu 'anhu' ('I admit by God that had it been written to me I would have been unable'); 'fa-inna l-bashar fi nafs al-amr sab' kalimat mutashabiha gharibat al-tarkib' (humans, in truth, are seven similar words of strange composition - a compliment on the cipher, uncertain wording).
plaintext_for: Line 1 finishes the block of f. 13r lines 11-13; lines 7-8 are a verse (probably the plaintext of that block, not certain). The cipher at lines 10-13 has no plaintext on this page (answer presumably on f. 14r).

contents.text: فحل ذلك سريعا لسهولته وهو
يا من له كل الموالي عبيد وبره في كل يوم يزيد / جدلي برسوم على عادتي بعودي [?] الشام نخيل البريد [?]

وكتب لي فسح الله في مدته لغزا من نظمه السعيد / وما علم على فرد مثنى رباعي [?] بارس [?] بالنجو [?] / نواصله [?] اذا اشينا بلام ونقطعه كما نهوى نجيم [?] / اذا نطق المغيظ بعكسه فالجواب بشطر راي الكريم / هو اسم معرب دخلت عليه حروف في زمن قديم / فكانت عاملات فيه رفعا ونصبا يستفز نهى الحليم / وان ضعف او حرف شيا فذاك الفعل يامر بالوجو [?]

correspondents.arabic: وكتب لي ... لغزا من نظمه السعيد
correspondents.translit: wa-kataba li ... lughzan min nazmihi al-sa'id: a grammatical riddle poem sent to the compiler by an unnamed correspondent (name not read; honorific 'fasaha llahu fi muddatihi')

technique_remarks: 'fa-halla dhalika sari'an li-suhulatihi wa-huwa' ('he solved that quickly because of its ease, and it is'): the compiler notes the block (7 lines) was easy. No letter-dropping or direction remark on this page. Lines 7-13 are a verse riddle (lughz) on Arabic grammar (ism mu'rab, 'awamil, raf' and nasb), not a cipher.
plaintext_for: Lines 5-6 are the plaintext verse answering the 7-line cipher block (f. 13v lines 10-13 + f. 14r lines 1-3). Lines 7-13 are a separate riddle poem the compiler received (a lughz in verse), which probably leads to the cipher on f. 14v.
certainty: low-medium for the verse words (several words doubtful, esp. line 6 and 8-9, 13 end); high for layout; worm hole at left margin lines 6-7; red-ink marginal word at line 11 left (not read).

contents.text: يري [?] فعلا وفعلا وهو فعل بين لصاحب القلب السليم  (end of the riddle verse begun on f. 14r)

فكتبت الجواب مترجما بنوع يسمى التصحيفي وهو ان / يجعل للشكل وما مثله من الحروف في العربي صورة / واحدة فيجعل الباء والتاء والثاء والنون والياء صورة / واحدة والجيم والحاء والخاء صورة واحدة والدال / والذال كذلك الى اخر الحروف

contents.direction_remark: 7 lines; very small repertoire of repeated signs (a K-shaped sign, a hook/three-stroke sign, a cursive 'ص' like sign, a comma-hook sign) consistent with the 'tashifi' scheme described above; dotted dividers about 5-6 per line; the block begins and ends at line margins; plaintext not on this page

technique_remarks: 'fa-katabtu al-jawab mutarjiman bi-naw' yusamma al-tashifi wa-huwa an yuj'ala li-l-shakl wa-ma mithlahu min al-huruf fi l-'arabi sura wahida fa-yuj'ala l-ba' wa-l-ta' wa-l-tha' wa-l-nun wa-l-ya' sura wahida wa-l-jim wa-l-ha' wa-l-kha' sura wahida wa-l-dal wa-l-dhal kadhalika ila akhir al-huruf' = 'I wrote the answer, encoded by a kind called the tashifi, which is that letters of the same shape in Arabic get one sign: ba', ta', tha', nun, ya' one sign; jim, ha', kha' one sign; dal, dhal likewise, to the end of the letters.' So: homograph (rasm-shape) merging, many-to-one, with the dots dropped.
plaintext_for: No plaintext on this page: the cipher block (lines 7-13) is answered on f. 15r (not on this page).
certainty: high for lines 2-6 (clear hand); low for line 1 (first word doubtful); high for layout; stain at top, worm hole at left lines 2-3.

contents.text: فحلها [?] وكتب منها ما ذكر  (same line as the last 2 cipher signs)

سلكنا مهمه القفر الصميم وخضنا حجب الليل البهيم / وجبنا بالمفاوز كل نائ [?] وردنا في السباسب كل ميم [?] / اردنا ان نفوز بعذب ماء وردنا في الفيافي شبه هيم / وردنا شرقها والغرب حتى وردنا شاطئ البحر العظيم / اخذنا عنك فصفا لدنيا [?] ورق وراق باللطف العميم / قصدنا ظلمه فضفا علينا وحولنا عن المرعى الوخيم / بغير تكلف حنو [?] ويغنيني وجبر الكسر من خيم وخيم [?]  (7 lines of 2 hemistichs, end rhyme -im; many words doubtful)

technique_remarks: 'fa-halla-ha wa-kataba minha ma dhukira' ('he solved it and wrote from it what is mentioned [below]'). The verse (a journey through desert wastes to the sea, a poem of thanks) is the plaintext quoted from the cipher; no further technique remark on this page.
plaintext_for: Lines 6-13 answer the tashifi cipher run (f. 14v line 7 to f. 16v line 6). Caution: the quoted verse is only 14 hemistichs (about 500 letters), while the cipher run is about 50 lines (some 900+ signs); 'wa-kataba minha ma dhukira' ('wrote from it what is mentioned') suggests the cipher was longer than the verse quoted (a letter of which the verse is an extract) - not resolved.
certainty: medium for layout, low-medium for the verse words (plain clear hand but I did not zoom; several words doubtful as marked); small page mark at bottom left (not read); worm hole at right margin line 8.

contents.text: كتب الى هنا وكتب تحتها [?] وبقية الالحان والفصل / معلوم اذ قد حل هذا القدر الكافي للسبب [?] / وسمه الجواب [?]

على [?] يا بان فضل الله حطت ركائب كل سباق عليم / بحل المشكلات وكل صعب بجلي الكرب والخطب الجسيم / يوشى بالبراع مدبجات تفوق قلائد الدر النظيم [?] / ويغني رايه والجاش جيشا عن الرايات بالملك العقيم [?] / زكا اصلا وفرعا فهو يدعى الكريم ابن الكريم ابن الكريم / الوف للفضائل والعطايا نفور عن مواحش كل [?] كريم / هو السم الذعاف لمن يبادي هو الحلو الفكاهة للنديم / وبلغني قاصده بطلق وجه واخلاق ارق من النسيم / اذا ما هم المغتاظ ياتي ببشر شيمة البر الحليم / بمنة ما فاه دهرا للمداني وصه ما قال يوما للغريم  (a praise poem, 10 lines of 2 hemistichs, rhyme -im; last words of lines 12-13 doubtful)

technique_remarks: 'kataba ila huna wa-kataba tahtaha wa-baqiyyat al-alhan wa-l-fasl ma'lum idh qad halla hadha l-qadr al-kafi li-l-[sabab?]' = 'he [the solver] wrote up to here and wrote beneath it, and the rest of the tunes/pieces and the section are known, since this sufficient portion has been solved' - i.e. the compiler gives only an extract of the long decipherment (confirms the doubt on f. 16v); 'wa-sammahu al-jawab' (and he named it/called it the answer) uncertain.
plaintext_for: Lines 4-13 are the end of the plaintext of the long tashifi cipher run (ff. 14v-16v), a praise poem for a generous patron ('al-karim ibn al-karim', not named here); with the 16v verse the plaintext quoted is 2 passages from the decipherment.
certainty: medium for lines 1-3 (a few doubtful words), low-medium for verse (single words doubtful as marked); stain and small worm holes at left margin lines 6-8; dotted vertical marks left margin line 8-9 (probably marginal dots, not read); show-through of f. 17v cipher at right edge.

contents.text: ولم يرم العدو بسهم نطق ومتكل على نجح فو[?] يم [?] / مضعف عكس ما انا فيه ونم بلا عود فاو زوج جيم / ومالي غيره من بعد ربي طبيب قربه برء السقيم / ادام الله رفعته ليبقى على الايام في عز مقيم  (end of the answer poem begun f. 16v/17r; line 1 first half doubtful)

لما الغز في المهمة صدرت به الجواب ولما ذكر / اللام ثم الجيم ذكرت الميم والميم البصير [?] في اللغة / ذكره الخليل في كتاب العين منقول من المجاب والخير / بالكسر الكرم والخيم الشيمة ذكرته لمجانسته ما قبله / في البيت وما قبله في القافية اطاعي [?] ومكمل / تام ومثله في التشبيه كريم مع الكرم قبله وانبت [?] / بلفظه مه [?] جواب قوله فذاك الفعل يامر بالوجوم وقبلها / همم جواب قوله اذا نطق المغيظ بعكسه وقول / بشمم [?] جواب قوله بلام فاللام السمم وان كان اللام انضا [?]
catchword at bottom left: اسم [?]

technique_remarks: Lines 5-13 are the compiler's commentary tying the solved cipher to the lughz (verse riddle) quoted on f. 14r: 'lamma l-lughz fi l-muhimma sadartu bihi l-jawab' ('since the riddle is in the [matter] I put it at the head of the answer'), then he lists the letters 'al-lam thumma al-jim ... dhakartu al-mim' and explains the rhyme-word mim/khim/khayr (citing al-Khalil, Kitab al-'Ayn: 'al-khim = al-shima, character; al-khir bi-l-kasr = generosity'), and matches each riddle clue ('fa-dhaka l-fi'l ya'muru bi-l-wujum', 'idha nataqa l-mughit bi-'aksihi', 'bi-lam') with an answer word. No cipher-mechanism remark. Authority named: al-Khalil (ibn Ahmad), Kitab al-'Ayn.
plaintext_for: Lines 1-4 finish the answer poem to the tashifi cipher run (ff. 14v-16v); lines 5-13 explain how the poem answers the riddle of f. 14r (so the tashifi cipher is the compiler's reply in verse to that riddle).
certainty: medium for layout, low-medium for the words (small hand, several doubtful as marked; I did not zoom); worm holes at right margin lines 7-9.

contents.text: اسم [?] المقدة [?] لغة حبشية لما ذكر واحتمل ارادته / اكتفا بالسهم ومثل مضعف عكس ما انا فيه الى / اخر الملكان [?] قد ذكر الجيم وفي اللغة الجيم الناقة المسنة / ذكرت الواو وهو الفحل من الابل فهو زوج الناقة / والفحل هو العود بالفتح فالعود هو الواو وبقوله بلا عود / اي اذا حذف من وهم الواو يبقى هم فاذا عكس / وضعف صار مهمها وهذا لا يفهمه الا بعض / الخواص فانه بعيد جدا ولحضرة الشيخ بدر الدين / حسن الجولاني مترجمات من انشاء على سبيل الامتحان / وهي الغاز ايضا اولها

contents.direction_remark: new block, a different sign style from ff. 14v-16v: rounded, hooked, looped forms (small bowls, ligature-like shapes, a few angular signs) with dotted dividers (about 3-5 per line); first of the 'mutarjamat' riddles ('wa-hiya alghaz aydan awwaluha' = 'they are also riddles, the first of them')

correspondents.translit: al-Shaykh Badr al-Din Hasan al-Jawlani (ligature reading al-Julani/al-Jawlani; ciphers composed for him 'ala sabil al-imtihan, as a test)

technique_remarks: Lines 2-7 finish the explanation of the riddle on f. 14r: a verse clue 'bila 'awd' ('without the stick/waw [male camel]') means drop the letter waw from 'wahm'; the remaining 'hamm' is reversed and doubled ('mudaʻʻaf 'aks') to give 'mahmah' (mahmah, 'desert') - uses al-jim = she-camel (naqa musinna), waw = stud camel (fahl, 'awd). Authority/lexical sources: 'lugha habashiyya' (Ethiopic word) for a word in line 1. Line 8-10: 'wa-li-hadrat al-Shaykh Badr al-Din Hasan al-Jawlani mutarjamat min insha' 'ala sabil al-imtihan wa-hiya alghaz aydan awwaluha' = 'for the Shaykh Badr al-Din Hasan al-Jawlani there are ciphered pieces of my composition, as a test; they are riddles too, the first of them'.
plaintext_for: The 3-line block at lines 11-13 has no plaintext on this page; its answer should follow on f. 18v. Lines 1-7 conclude the commentary on the previous riddle.
certainty: medium for lines 1-10 (clear hand, several words doubtful as marked); high for cipher layout; stain top and left; worm holes left margin line 7-9.

contents.direction_remark: continues the 3-line block of f. 18r lines 11-13 (12 lines in all); same rounded/hooked sign style; dotted dividers about 2-4 per line (fewer than in the tashifi block, see the compiler's remark 'ahmala fawasil kathira'); line 9 has only 3 signs and a divider, so the block ends there

contents.text: فحللته سريعا ووجدته قد عمل الدال صيغتين / وقد اهمل فواصل كثيرة وهو [?] (faint show-through or erased words at line 11 centre, not read)

بامر ففك الرمز الذي اقوله من غير اعياء ماذا ترى شو [?] ثابتا في صح [?] / منكوسه الراس لحزونه قد دقها الدهر بالاناء ترزق [?] بالنار فراخا من بعد [?] / ما يسوز بالماء [?]  (interlinear words 'wa-asma' [?] above line 13 right; the verse reading is very uncertain)

technique_remarks: 'fa-halaltuhu sari'an wa-wajadtuhu qad 'amila l-dal sighatayn' = 'I solved it quickly and found he had made the dal in two forms (two signs for dal)'; 'wa-qad ahmala fawasil kathira' = 'and he had omitted many separators (word dividers)' - so this block has two signs for dal and dropped word dividers.
